scope: Independent targeted proof-scope audit plus all-page layout inspection of the final 130-page manuscript and 4-page guide. This is not a complete independent mathematical reproof or a new enumeration/certificate replay.
checked: General statement has no pivotal, spherical or unitary assumption; existence classes and necessary-data survivors are separated.
General M9 advancement retains PU-only results unless an explicit general reduction is verified; exceptions and exhausted budgets do not exclude.

All 293 inherited chapter labels retained. Aside from chapters 01,02,05,07 and gauss_family, inherited chapter files are byte-identical; mathematical content in reviewed edits of 05 and gauss_family is retained.
Formal-codegree trace ideal and biquadratic criteria derive signed sphericalization and dimension-field containment without assuming sphericality of the input category.
Weighted induction for the new noncommutative R6_9_71 includes and verifies the two-FP-dimensions general-to-PU gate.
Central packet theorem uses nondegenerate decomposition of the center, not a decomposition of the input category; V^T V = N_A is justified by adjunction without dominance.
Homogeneous weighted AMV identity and the mod-3 spin specialization are consistent under the stated ribbon and charge assumptions.
Inherited frontier text treats unique restriction/modular profiles and a single necessary relative-center based ring as necessary data, not categorification.
Classification proof references the trace-ideal, biquadratic, weighted-induction, signed and general-to-positive mechanisms used by current M9 certificates.

New multiplicity-nine chapter keeps all eleven residuals generally unresolved, records six pivotal/spherical/PU/unitary nonexistence claims separately, and does not infer model existence from surviving necessary constraints.

Pivotal plus self-duality of every simple implies sphericality by equality of left/right dimensions on simples and semisimplicity. Six canonical tensor dual maps and the certificate wrapper were checked.

R6_9_3748 rank-three subring products and all five displayed square supports match the canonical tensor. Simplicity and nonintegrality of that braided subcategory force nondegeneracy, and the rank-two centralizer contradiction follows from the cited DGNO decomposition theorem. This excludes braiding, without excluding arbitrary fusion-category existence.

Final manuscript, guide and tables agree on 25,421 census rings, 25,351 general exclusions, 57 realized rings (56 unitary and one spherical non-PU), and 13 general residuals; the M9 stratum contributes 8,798 exclusions and 11 residuals.
disposition: No blocking mathematical-scope or layout error found in the reviewed material. The guide rebuild command-list split was corrected and visually rechecked.
